meta.principle: IPM-first: non-chemical actions are listed before any chemical; chemicals only when scouting/ETL justifies.
meta.note: Every action is non-chemical and carries source_pdf + line. No chemical name or dose belongs in this file.

actions.action: Maintain standing water level of 5-10 cm in the rice field (adjust per growth stage: 5-7 cm at tillering/flowering, 3-5 cm at dead-heart stage)
At tillering and panicle-formation stages keep field water level 5-7 cm; at dead-heart stage regulate it to 3-5 cm
Where field drainage is not possible, control weeds by hoeing twice in kharif rice (25 and 45 days after transplanting) and once in rabi rice (40 DAT)
Use the KKV cono weeder for mechanical weeding in rice (capacity about 0.011 ha/hour; leaves no weed, works in puddled fields)
Spread Giripushpa (Tephrosia) green manure at 1 tonne/ha in nursery rows for effective weed control and stronger seedlings
Scout fields and treat only when infestation reaches the economic threshold: 5% dead hearts or 1 female moth per square metre

actions.target: rice blast and bacterial leaf blight
actions.action: In problem fields prefer resistant variety BM-4 (Karjat Shatabdi): resistant to stem borer, bacterial blight and blast

actions.target: rice leaf blast and bacterial leaf blight
actions.action: Consider Ratnagiri-7 (RTN RR4): resistant to stem borer, leaf folder, gall midge; moderately resistant to leaf blast and bacterial leaf blight

actions.target: rice leaf blast and bacterial leaf blight
actions.action: Consider Karjat-184: moderately resistant to bacterial leaf blight and blast, tolerant to brown planthopper and white-backed planthopper
Consider Karjat-8: resistant to neck blast and moderately resistant to leaf blast (low-land areas)
